summary: Michael Laush fell headfirst into ~6 ft of snow while skiing at Vail on Jan 19; buried head-down ~6-7 min with no breathing and no pulse for ~10 min. ~6 Good Samaritans dug him out; bystanders (Vail dermatologist Karen Nern, retired OBGYN Beth McCrann) administered CPR — pulse returned after three rounds of chest compressions. Transported to Denver Health; made a quick recovery and was cleared to leave.
responding_agency: Unknown (Good Samaritan rescue; Vail Ski Patrol also responded per Vail Daily)
notes: Snow-immersion burial, not avalanche; matches id 3282 precedent (2016-01-05 Vail tree-well fatality, other). 2019-01-19 = Saturday. WKYC 3 interview article 2019-01-29 names incident date January 19th; SnowBrains carries the same incident. In-bounds at Vail Mountain (frontcountry). Rescuer names from UN article; Vail Daily photo caption confirms CPR before ski patrol arrived.
